2608.13129.title: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement
2608.13129.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks yet remain unreliable on elementary numerical tasks, including magnitude comparison, large-integer arithmetic, fractions, and scientific notation. This survey examines basic numerical understanding as a capability distinct from high-level mathematical reasoning. We propose the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeracy into Representational Grounding (RG), mapping numeral forms to value, magnitude, and equivalent representations, and Procedural Grounding (PG), executing arithmetic operations in accordance with their mathematical definitions. Using NGF, we organize recent diagnostic benchmarks, failure modes, structural explanations, and mitigation strategies. We review evidence concerning tokenization, positional encoding, embedding geometry, and pretraining-data distribution. We also apply NGF in a coordinated evaluation of three frontier model families across Number Cookbook, NumericBench, and GSM-Symbolic, comparing atomic, contextual, and reasoning-assisted numeracy. Architectural interventions such as digit-aware tokenization and Abacus Embeddings can improve models trained from scratch but are generally unavailable to users of pretrained systems, for whom supervised fine-tuning, reasoning scaffolds, and external tools are more practical. We conclude with deployment recommendations and research directions for more reliable numerical behavior in foundation models.
2608.13129.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在數學推理基準上取得了強勁的結果，但在基本數字任務上仍然不可靠，包括大小比較、大整數算術、分數和科學記數法。這項調查考察了基本數字理解，作為一種與高級數學推理不同的能力。我們提出了數字基礎框架（NGF），將數字能力分解為表徵基礎（RG），將數字形式映射到數值、大小和等效表示，以及程序基礎（PG），根據其數學定義執行算術運算。利用NGF，我們組織了最近的診斷基準、失敗模式、結構解釋和緩解策略。我們回顧了有關標記化、位置編碼、嵌入幾何和預訓練數據分佈的證據。我們還在Number Cookbook、NumericBench和GSM-Symbolic上對三個前沿模型家族進行了協調評估，比較了原子、上下文和推理輔助的數字能力。像數字感知標記化和算盤嵌入這樣的架構干預可以改善從零開始訓練的模型，但對於使用預訓練系統的用戶來說，這些方法通常不可用，對他們而言，監督微調、推理支架和外部工具更為實用。我們以部署建議和基礎模型中更可靠的數字行為的研究方向作結。
